label: Brake noise
comp_systems: SERVICE BRAKES|SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC|SERVICE BRAKES, AIR|PARKING BRAKE
note: A sound from the brakes. Distinct from brake_failure: no loss of braking is required.

label: Brakes did not stop the vehicle
comp_systems: SERVICE BRAKES|SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC|SERVICE BRAKES, AIR
require_all: brake|break;fail|failure|not stop|no brake|lost brake|loss brake|brake stop work|brake not work|pedal floor|soft pedal|pedal soft|spongy|brake went out|brake gave out|unable stop
note: Loss or reduction of braking. Distinct from brake_noise: a sound alone is not this concept.

label: Steering wheel shake or vibration
note: Shaking felt in the wheel or front end. Distinct from power_steering_loss: the assist still works.

label: Loss of power steering assist
require_all: steer|steering;hard turn|difficult turn|hard steer|stiff|lost power steer|loss power steer|no power steer|power steer fail|power steer failure|power steer stop|power steer not work|power steer went out|power steer assist|steer lock up|steer locked|heavy steer|steer heavy|steer assist
note: Steering becomes heavy or assist is lost. Distinct from steering_vibration: shaking alone is not this concept.

label: Door does not lock
require_all: door|lock|latch;not lock|lock not work|lock not|lock broken|lock broke|lock fail|lock failure|lock stop work|unable lock|lock malfunction|lock inoperative|lock stuck|lock jam
note: The lock does not engage or the lock mechanism does not work. Distinct from door_opens_while_driving: the door stays closed.

label: Door opens while the vehicle is moving
require_all: door|hatch|liftgate|tailgate;open drive|open while drive|flew open|fly open|came open|come open|open itself|open by itself|open on own|not stay close|not stay shut|pop open|swung open|swing open|open unexpectedly|open in motion|open during|not latch|unlatch
note: The door or hatch opens or will not stay closed in motion. Distinct from door_wont_lock: a lock that does not engage is not this concept.

label: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
comp_systems: ENGINE|ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING|ELECTRICAL SYSTEM|FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM|FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE|FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL|POWER TRAIN|VEHICLE SPEED CONTROL
require_all: stall|shut off|shut down|die|died|dying|cut out|cut off|turn off|quit;drive|highway|freeway|interstate|mph|speed|stop light|red light|stop sign|intersection|traffic|accelerate|moving|motion
note: The engine stops while the vehicle is in use. Distinct from wont_start: the engine was running.

label: Engine does not start
comp_systems: ENGINE|ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING|ELECTRICAL SYSTEM|FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM|FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE|FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL|POWER TRAIN
require_all: not start|no start|not crank|no crank|not turn over|fail start|unable start
note: The engine does not start from rest. Distinct from stall_while_driving: nothing says it stopped while driving.
